messages:
Alex C: Heads-up — we need to finalize acceptance criteria for keystore + audit evidence for the next launch gate. SOC2/ISO reviewers asked for concrete retention windows and HSM/KMS clarity. Can we align this week?
Maria P: Quick q — are we requiring HSM for all deployments or is 'KMS backed by HSM' sufficient for hosted?
Jamal R: From infra: HSM mandatory for Private (on-prem/VPC) customers. For Hosted we can support Cloud KMS with HSM-backed keys (customer or provider-managed) but need clear attestation artifacts.
Priya (Security): We should be explicit in the PRD: three acceptance buckets — retention policy (logs + keystore metadata), cryptographic boundary (HSM vs KMS with attestations), and evidence packaging (what exact artifacts to provide).
Sophia L: Proposed acceptance checklist draft: 
- Audit logs retained >= 1 year (configurable up to 7y). 
- Keystore wrapping keys are non-exportable; proof = KMS key policy + rotation history. 
- Private deployments: HSM-backed CMKs with vendor attestation. 
- Hosted: KMS with HSM-backed keys + signed attestation docs.
Alex C: Can someone enumerate the minimal set of artifacts we'll hand to reviewers for the launch gate? e.g., sample audit log, key policy snippet, rotation proof, HSM attestation or KMS export-proof.
InfraBot: deploy-bot: created INF-789: "keystore audit evidence collection" — link: https://rwd.company/INF-789
Jamal R: Edge case — transient worker nodes in customer VPC may write logs locally before they hit our ingest; clarify: we need either networked log forwarding or customer-signed attestations saying they retained original copies. Add to acceptance: 'evidence for inbound log integrity when network boundaries exist'.
Maria P: @Priya I can draft the PRD paragraph + a short acceptance checklist. I'll also ask legal for wording on "customer-managed keys" vs "provider-managed keys".
Priya (Security): Add two mandatory items: key-compromise response plan (procedures + SLAs) and forensic-readiness evidence (how to preserve chain-of-custody). Those must be in the acceptance docs.
Sophia L: I'll add the redaction guidance to prevent sending PII in logs (examples and grep/redact commands). Also adding a sample artifact bundle layout: /evidence/{component}/{artifact}.{json|txt} and signature metadata.
Alex C: Plan: Maria drafts baseline PRD text + checklist; Sophia enriches artifacts + redaction notes; Jamal verifies infra feasibility and lists any blocked items; Priya to sign off on security items. Target: EOD Friday.
Priya (Security): I'll review Thu morning and flag any blockers. If something is missing I'll escalate to Compliance.
Maria P: Sounds good, uploading draft into the PRD doc after this thread. Will ping when done. :thumbsup:
